title: Surreal Divided Realms
description: A man in a long dark coat stands at the center of an ornate oval frame, holding two circular vignettes. The left vignette shows a lavender field with a lone walker under a geometric sky, while the right depicts a red rocky landscape with an alien-like creature holding a globe. The background features multiple stylized faces, a three-eyed UFO, constellations, and geometric patterns.
prompt: A surreal symbolic illustration of a man in a long dark coat standing inside an ornate oval mandala frame, holding two circular scenes in his hands. Left circle shows a peaceful purple lavender field with a walking figure, right circle shows a cracked red alien landscape with a strange creature holding a planet. Multiple expressive faces float above, a three-eyed UFO hovers in the top right, intricate geometric patterns, constellations and triangles frame the composition, ink line art with watercolor washes in purple and red tones
